context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT test-methodology finding: the mcp_browser_automation tool's `page_url` param, when different across separate tool invocations, appears to launch a fresh browser context (localStorage wiped) rather than reusing the same session - so testing a 'fresh page load / deep link' scenario against previously-created state MUST be done within a SINGLE script invocation using `await page.goto(url, wait_until='networkidle')` for the 'fresh reload' step (this preserves localStorage/AsyncStorage of the same origin while still forcing a full JS bundle reload + store re-hydration), rather than issuing a separate tool call with a different page_url (which loses all prior state and would produce a false-positive bug report). All other previously-verified features (bilan overview sheet, section celebration, plan suggestion, badges, BadgeCelebration modal, Today all-done banner, Reglages reminder settings) were not re-tested per main agent's request, only touched incidentally during setup flow and worked without issue.
rca_of_issue: N/A - both fixes confirmed resolved. Original RCA from iteration_2 (stale useState initializer for FIX1, ambiguous '/' route resolution for FIX2) matches the applied code fixes exactly and both now behave correctly under fresh-reload test conditions.
